title: Counter-scan configuration
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $x$ and $s$ be Boolean words, let $p$ be one of the $|x|+2$ input-head positions, and let $kt$ and $kh$ specify contents and head positions for the work tapes of $K$. The clock machine configuration has state $cScan$, input-head position $p$, empty output, and blank work tapes and zero head positions in the simulated $W$ block. Its $K$ block is given by $kt$ and $kh$; the intervening buffer tape stores $s$ starting at cell $j-1$, with its head at $j-1$, where $j\in\mathbb N$.
